notes.title: Update 3.0.5.0 - Merging the Legacy and Beach Resort Versions!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are excited to present a new update for Spirit of the Island, where we finally can ditch the legacy version and have a unified experience between all platforms: PC, Console and upcoming Mobile! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/724c7d047e0803f9188af15180f3efb86377c827.jpg[/img]

We will present patchnotes for both PC and Console versions, respectively. 

[b]PC:[/b]
- Fixed various errors in coop mode;
- By merging the version, we've reduced the size of the game by half! Meaning that the install size will be ~3GB.
- Fixed various problems with controllers;
- Fixed an old bug with marriage;
- We've added drag and drop system for PC version! Now you can manage your inventories more conveniently;
- We've also optimised the game to load faster;
- We've changed the Host-Second player interaction the New Story coop mode: now, only the host can finish the active quests. Second player can still interact with all NPCs and do everything else. This was done to ensure maximum compatibility and stability of the gameplay in New Story. 
- Fixed rare issue, when achievements didn't unlock for some players;
- Fixed a very rare issue, when host's and second players save files were swapped.

More fixes for PC version will come soon after the Mobile release, probably in about two weeks from the date.

[b]PC and Console versions are now exactly the same, so there is no launch option for a legacy one now. You just need to launch the game, select region and play![/b]

[b]Consoles:[/b]
- Added the new story
- This update also adds Adventureland and Beach Resort DLCs with all of their content for free!
- All above fixes for achievements, controllers and other issues.

As a reminder: you can opt for the launch of SOTI on mobile stores! Here are the links:
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pid.spirit]Android[/url]

Hi! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/c991cca2671ae6ad6b33739afb7a93140e20cdb7.jpg[/img]

We have another small bugfix update ready:
- We have resolved the large savefile problem - this time completely. There's only one thing: you would need to delete two large txt files in your savegame folder. Sadly, you will lose [i][b]all of your quest[/b][/i] progress - we found no way to avoid this - but all your other progress, including buildings, items, relationships, etc. will remain intact. [i][b]IMPORTANT: only people that have encountered this issue have to do it! Please do not delete anything if your game works fine![/b][/i]

* Input %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/1M Bits Horde

And in early summer, we will release a new story and all updated stuff for consoles, finally merging the two versions together. Please wait for the news about both releases!

We’d like to say a huge thanks to our community for supporting us for such a long time. We are preparing a lot of exciting things and new games, so we hope you stick with us for the new releases!

Yours dearly,

1M Bits Horde and Meta Publishing.

notes.title: Spirit of the Island: End of Year Summary
notes.notes:
Hello friends! It’s Christmas and we think it’s a good time to make a summary of what we did in 2023. But first and foremost: Merry Christmas! Spend this lovely festive season in the company of your friends and family, eat nice food, play good games, and enjoy the Holidays!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/afcdc65c9b5a1a0c5a863f9b87e241b07b9efba4.jpg[/img]

Now, where shall we start? The beginning of the year was all focused on patches and fixes, such as new controller support, vehicle controls and other things that made the whole experience more refined. In February, we conducted a very important player survey (.... !) which helped shape our release strategy for 2023.. Now, not everything went exactly as planned: we had some pushbacks, but all of them were done because we wanted to increase the quality of our releases and provide the best experience possible. We are very grateful for all the feedback that you provided to us: which made Spirit of the Island the game it is today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/4849b2be3843e1fba1043ead49afa75c4ad43de9.png[/img]

Let’s fast forward a bit: it’s June 1st, Summer is starting and with that, the beach season. A great time to visit a tropical resort, right? We thought so as well and launched Beach Resort: the first DLC for the Spirit of the Island for free! It added a whole new starting island with plenty of free space to build the resort of your dreams. The reception for the DLC was amazing, as everyone wanted a bigger island for a long time. We are very happy with the reception! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/25956fbd15764498e2ad89c26ec8cc860880b518.jpg[/img]

Let’s go to July, as then we had a very important announcement:  Cross-Platform features for consoles and mobile game versions. Spirit of the Island is the very first game in the genre, that you can play together with your friends, no matter the platform: PC or Console and in the future, mobile. And just a bit later, in August, SOTI got a permanent price reduction on the PC. All in all, Summer was a very fruitful season for the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/0eebcbc1f2d5aca20115b3760c5a7426bf1424f1.jpg[/img]

And the fun didn’t stop in September too: we revealed our plans for the end of the year, console release date, and new storyline update release date. The first one in line was Adventureland, the second DLC for the Spirit of the Island. It was released in October and got great feedback from our community. Combined with the beach resort, the possibilities to expand and create your resort were never as big as they are now. And a few weeks later, on October 19th, we launched console versions of the game with the crossplay feature. Oh! We forgot to mention, that SOTI became fully compatible with Steam Deck as well, meaning that you can play on the go with your friends, who own a Switch or another Steam Deck — how cool is that?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/816e12094422e7ff12a24051db92dec08ff4bf46.png[/img]

This year is not over yet though! There’s one more thing ahead of us to launch: The New Storyline update. It’s a major revamp of all quest and story systems, so it took us more time to develop and now we are in the process of testing. It’s taking some more time, but we think that it will be ready at the start of next year. Playtest is coming soon too!

Huge thanks to EVERYONE in our community! We are truly blessed to have you with us. 

Merry Christmas!

notes.title: An Announcement Regarding New Story Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have a very important announcement to make today: the New Story Update will be delayed. We don’t have a date yet, but we are hoping to release it this month. 

The reason for the delay is the complexity of the update. To make sure everything works smoothly, we created a completely new quest system from scratch. The one that we’ve used before didn’t allow us to make big changes to quest generation, rewards, and quest complexity. That’s why a decision to make a totally new system was made. We were positive that it would be ready in November, but testing showed us that there are still quite a few things to polish before we can release it to you, our players. 

We are going to launch a public test update as soon as we have a build. You will be able to try the new update before release and help us hunt bugs in public testing because we can’t catch everything with our internal QA, it’s simply not possible for a game of this calibre. We will put out an announcement a few days prior to the release of the public test. The test will be completely optional, so if you want to only play the full experience, you can skip it and wait for the full release, which will come after we fix everything that will be reported to us.

We know that the delay is not ideal, but we don’t want to release a buggy update with the potential to break everyone’s old and new save games. No one wants that. We hope you understand our concerns and reasons for this drastic measure. In return, we can promise that the wait is worth it and the game will see major improvements to its story and questing parts — in both single-player and coop modes.

If you have any questions, you can ask us in the comments for the news, or in our Discord server. 

Thank you for always supporting us,

The teams at Meta Publishing and 1M Bits Horde.

[h2]A small reminder about Cross-Play and how it works[/h2]

With Cross-Play, you will be able to play the coop mode of Spirit of the Island with all your friends, regardless of the platform (PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch). You don't need to do anything special to enable this mode on consoles, but on PC there are some steps that need to be done before you can play with consoles. 

[b]Please note that this is temporary until console edition gets all updates.[/b]
1. Right click on Spirit of the Island in your Steam library. 
 - If you are playing on GOG, then go to game settings and untick "DLC"
 - For EGS, you just need to launch basic Spirit of the Island game in your library. 
2. Go to "Properties"
3. Go to "DLC" section.
4. Disable all DLCs. 
5. Launch your game.
6. Before starting a new save, make sure to untick "use DLC save" checkbox. 
7. Proceed to play!

[h2]Why you can't use DLCs for now? [/h2]
To release console version faster, we had to exclude DLCs and other updates. Please rest assured that all content will arrive not long after the release, together with the new story. Adventureland will arrive as a separate paid DLC, just like on PC. 

We hope you enjoy the console version of the game!

We have decided to do the opposite and instead make Spirit of the Island more affordable for the players. We sincerely think that we'd be better off by having a more active and alive community, than by making a few more $.

2. As many of you know, console version with crossplay is coming later this year (Q4 2023), with mobile version to follow later on in the future. This is also the reason why we want to SOTI to be a more affordable game for everyone. Won't it be fun to play with all your friends no matter the platform of choice?

notes.title: Update 0.20.1
The Dragon Boat Festival!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today is the Dragon Boat Festival - a traditional Chinese holiday which occurs on the fifth day of the fifth month of the Chinese calendar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/8a95d3f6cd5122622f6066ff4f1dda0b269b91c9.png[/img]

There are several stories tied to the origin of this event:

The ancient one says that this national holiday originated as a ritual, which will help avoid bad luck. But why the bad luck in June? You see, people believed that fifth month of the calendar is unlucky and that illness and natural disasters are more common at this time of year. 

But a more commonly believed story tells us that the festival commemorates the passing of Qu Yuan, a poet and minister in the ancient state of Chu.  When the emperor decided to ally with the increasingly powerful state of Qin, Qu was banished for opposing the alliance and even accused of treason. During his exile, Qu Yuan wrote a great deal of poetry. Twenty-eight years later, Qin captured Ying, the Chu capital. In despair, Qu Yuan committed suicide by drowning himself in the Miluo River.

It is said that the local people, who admired him, raced out in their boats to save him, or at least retrieve his body. This is said to have been the origin of dragon boat races. When his body could not be found, they dropped balls of sticky rice into the river so that the fish would eat them instead of Qu Yuan's body. This is said to be the origin of zongzi - is a traditional Chinese rice dish made of glutinous rice stuffed with different fillings and wrapped in bamboo leaves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/7f4a4c95887c81b93f7d432fc29160813a81819a.jpg[/img]
[i]Photo Credit: 內灣野薑花粽 by Flickr user shenghunglin[/i]

You might be thinking "why tell you this?". Well, we kinda stumbled upon and thought that it could be really cool to try and recreate some of the historic events in Spirit of the Island later on.[b] Would you like to see time-limited themed events in the game? Please tell us in the comments! [/b]

As for the date, sadly, we don't have boat racing or zongzi, but you can do a memorial voyage across the Archipelago with your friend to commemorate the date - it's the thought that counts after all.

Have a great weekend everyone - we are looking forward for your thoughts!

[*] Tourists will have an icon in mini map now, when they want to buy something.

[*] Improved texts for special item quests.
[*] Improved texts for Skills (social mostly).

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed water pump not working for both players in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed wrong cave sound when you go deeper inside.
[*] Fixed description for Juices on Skill window.
[*] Fixed problem with all terrains during Winter (some places had dark/black texture when winter starts or game was loaded).
[*] Fixed exploit where players could get unlimited XP when talking to a few NPCs for the first time.
[*] Fixed exploit where players could get infinite iron from Fences in town.
[*] Fixed problems with Social skills (discounts, better prices, etc).
[*] Fixed bug where players could buy items for a given price and then sell for another (exploit).
[*] Fixed trade buy/sell item not updating the text.
[*] Fixed Alina map not disappearing after you finish the quest. For saved games, it will remove the item for you on start.

notes.title: Update v0.17.5
Spirit of the Island - Update 0.17.4
Important Announcement Regarding Online Play in China!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

We have received many reports about problems with coop play in China. We are deeply sorry about this, and the fix is on the way; it will take us a few days to get it ready. 

[b]The Problem[/b]
We are using Amazon servers to sync the data between players and the server, but they are getting blocked in China. We never knew this would happen and are making an alternative solution for our Chinese players right at this moment. 

[b]There are two workarounds:[/b]

1. You can try using VPN - this should solve all issues with online play. While it's a less than optimal experience, it should make your game work fine while we are preparing the update. 
2. While not a fix, you can always try our single-player campaign while you wait. It has more quests and the first part of the story, which is fun and should keep you occupied for a few days. 

Again, we are deeply sorry about the issues. We are doing our best to fix everything ASAP. 

Thank you for supporting Spirit of the Island!

notes.title: Release Date Reveal!
notes.notes:
Hello friends! How’s it going?

The big day is finally here! We are proud to announce that we are ready to reveal the release date of Early Access!

As we’ve announced before, we decided to postpone the Early Access release to ensure the best possible launch for everyone, and that commitment still stands. Now we are in a place where we can guarantee the best possible experience for everyone - from our dear Backers to all the new players.  So mark the date in your calendars, folks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/54ab042c340bf0df1ce84e776e51e91d332de215.jpg[/img]
 
We’ve prepared many fun activities for the Early Access launch too! A little teaser: we’ll be having a fun contest with very nice prizes, so hone your creative skills. But that’s all we can say right now!

New Features Awaiting You in Early Access
While we did move the release further into the future, the work has never ceased, and Spirit of the Island is looking better than ever. Since November, we’ve been running a special Backer Access version for our Kickstarter backers. And it’s going on incredibly well! Our amazing backers gave us lots of valuable feedback. We’ve already implemented many things that otherwise wouldn’t be in the Early Access day one. To list some examples:

[list]
[*] Repair function — now you can use your hammer to fix other tools (not another hammer, though!) at the expense of the hammer’s durability;
[*] Toggling “Item Drag” in the settings — sometimes you don’t need a magnet for dropped items so that it can be safely disabled now;
[*] Improved water — it looks better than ever now;
[*] Added key bindings, one of the most requested features;
[*] Two new Islands for you to explore!
[/list]
And lots of other stuff! We dive deeper into our latest additions in the development blog, which we released a few weeks before. If you missed it - here it is!

[previewyoutube=ZHysTJ-KhI4;full][/previewyoutube]
 
And we aren’t stopping here! Spirit of the Island is all about community-driven development so expect even more feedback-based changes and improvements when we go into Early Access!

We are super excited and can't wait to launch Spirit of the Island officially! Nothing of this would have been possible without the help and support of our dear Backers and the amazing community. To everyone - HUGE thanks!

We'll see you in March!

notes.title: Introducing Tropical Postcards - Our First Community Driven Event!
notes.notes:
Hello, Adventurers!

We are super excited to announce Tropical Postcards - our very first community-driven event!

We want to keep this message short and stay on point. Our goal is simple: making SOTI a bigger and better game. We want to join forces with our community and work towards that goal, together.

“So how can I help” I hear you ask? Well it couldn’t be any more simple! Just wishlist the game and tell your friends! The Postcards represent milestones that we need to hit. For each milestone we achieve, we can add new features into the game. Every time we hit a milestone, we’ll announce the next feature that will make its way into the game at launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/1d660ef92a0e792096ef632ffe870905566b1a05.png[/img]

And there's quite a lot of things to unlock! The first milestone is Pets, and we are already really close to achieving it, with the current amount of wishlists being around 32,000. What goes after will remain a secret for now - we don't want to spoil the fun! But everyone is welcome to try and guess in the comments or Steam discussions - you might know the answer already *wink*. 

As mentioned, the requirement to enter is very simple - just add Spirit of the Island to your wishlist. That's it! If you'd like to do it right now, here's a little widget: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592110/Spirit_of_the_Island/

What else can you do to reach the goal? Spread the news! Invite your friends and family to try the multiplayer demo together, share the news of socials - every little bit helps! We'll reveal the next milestone as soon as we reach the first one. 

Oh, one more thing: make sure to screenshot or record your best creations and moments in the demo! Why? You'll know soon :) 

Thank you for being with us and let's enjoy this adventure together!

The game will feature 14 unique islands. Quite a lot of places to explore! Here’s the game’s map so you have a better idea of how it will look after you visit everything (work in progress, some of these might change).

First things first: to visit other islands, you’ll need to pick one of the three different boats. A more expensive boat will allow you to reach faraway shores (they also require resources, like fuel that you can craft yourself). We bet you’ve noticed that some islands don’t have an anchor sign. That’s because these can’t be reached by sea, and you’ll visit them through different means, which will remain secret until Early Access lands. Here’s a little hint: explorable caves that are filled with lots of different riches, secrets, and fearsome enemies, like this little guy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/caa03d9d42fab920eaa4585ace3c323f2835b136.png[/img]

While exploring, you can also unlock different regions and POIs (points of interest) on your map. There will be quests, unique creatures, and fauna in many of those places. Exploration is also a key to exploring your pa... Whoops! Can’t tell anything more! No spoilers in our updates!

notes.title: Patch 0.10.14 is Live!
Patch v.0.10.12 for the Demo is Live!
notes.notes:
Hi! We just released a new update, which will address the common issues and your feedback! Huge thanks to everyone in the community for helping us improve the game! More updates will come later, so stay tuned!

NEW
- You can now name your chests.
- Added a few more items for the demo.

CHANGES
- Improved performance for low, medium, and high graphic setups. 
- Drastically improved the performance of rain.
- Improved physics check.
- Improved localization for harvesting.
- Increased the number of light points, even on low graphic settings.
- Improved backpack scrolling.
- Improved player movement.
- Machete does not require combat skill to craft it now.
- Improved stairs colliders.

FIXES
- Fixed destroyed chests, not dropping the items inside.
- Fixed the crafting warning: now it properly disappears.
- Fixed the case when you could gather or use items while being far away from them.
- Plants that were already harvested no longer show up as harvestable.
- You can't shake stumps now. 
- Beehive is now destroyed when a tree is chopped down (you need to start a new game for this fix to work).
- Fixed wrong crafting output when crafting items.
- Fixed wrong crop collider (after changing player movement).
- Fixed invisible wall problem near the mountains.
- Items won't disappear from treasure chests after you exit the game now. (you need to start a new game for this fix to work).

notes.title: Ask Us Anything!
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers! We are happy to officially open the Steam page for Spirit of the Island! 

Of course the most observant of you have noticed that it has been public for some time now - thank you for keeping it secret!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/4e5f8b88dc220cb714aea2b5f1dd3b4be6d15899.gif[/img]

To celebrate the occasion, we’ve prepared a short blog with some facts about the game! Please enjoy and feel free to ask any kinds of questions!
[list]
[*] SOTI will have about 14 explorable islands! The number is not final, but this is our goal at this moment!
[*] The pirates are your main enemies in the game! Beware of them while exploring different islands and try to not bring too many things with you - they’ll surely try to take them away!
[*] The game will have 4 different seasons, just like in real life: Summer, Autumn, Spring, and Winter. They’ll also affect pretty much everything around you, be it animals or plants!
[*] Speaking about animals, you’ll be able to adopt cats and dogs!
[*] The game will have explorable caves with lots of useful loot! But people say that ferocious Cave Worms also inhabit these and will attack anyone, who disturbs them. Will you take that risk?
[*] Last, but not least: NPCs. The game will feature a relationship system between you and other characters. Being on their good side will be very beneficial for you so we suggest befriending them all!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/8248723687c30356c4f50c0537ea9b35cc0519a0.gif[/img]

Feel free to ask us any questions in the comments and we’ll try our best to give you the best reply we can! More information to come soon, so stay tuned for our news!

Don’t forget to wishlist the game and see you around!
